summary: mkdir makes folders and touch makes empty files. Use them to set up a place for a new project.
notes: mkdir -p projects/web/css makes web and css in one step, and it does not complain if they already exist.
ls -R shows each folder followed by its contents, so you can check the whole tree at once.
ls shows 'lab notes.txt' in quotes because the name has a space. The quotes are not part of the name.
pitfall: touch lab notes.txt without quotes makes two files, lab and notes.txt. Put quotes around names with spaces, or use a dash or underscore instead (lab-notes.txt).
